headline: Reauthorizes the National Integrated Drought Information System, a federal drought early-warning program run through NOAA, through fiscal year 2018.
what_it_does: This law extends the National Integrated Drought Information System (NIDIS), a federal program that gives drought warnings and information. It states that the program's goal is to help people make timely decisions that reduce the impacts and costs of drought. The program must provide a drought early warning system with national and regional information, forecasts, and assessments. It also lets the government name one or more cooperative institutes to help, and requires NOAA's head to report to Congress on the program.

who_it_affects.how: They may receive drought forecasts and assessments from the program to help plan for dry conditions.
They may use regional drought early warning information to make decisions about water and emergency planning.
NOAA must run the program, work with cooperative institutes, and report to Congress on it.

when_it_takes_effect: Enacted March 6, 2014; the program's authorization runs through fiscal year 2018.
